_readme: Small config the agent reads/writes each run. artifactUrl is filled in after the first successful publish and must be reused (not regenerated) on every subsequent run so updates land on the same page instead of creating a new one each day.
pagesPublishScope: every run — uses GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN if set (scheduled cloud runs), else the local gh CLI
lastRunStatus: Weekly research run: no new opportunities founded (Product Management/QA/Data Engineering/Help Desk searches all came back short of the reliability≥3 bar for founding evidence). One score decrease from a mandatory red-team pass: ai-automates-tier1-security-operations 4→3 (a comprehensive arXiv survey of deployed LLM-based SOC tooling finds current systems remain advisory rather than autonomous, with hallucination/false-positive risk when granted acting authority — clears the reliability≥3 downgrade threshold, now contested). Two never-before-searched Federal Reserve regional banks (Dallas, Atlanta) yielded first-search corroboration for ai-productivity-reallocated-not-cut, already at breadth ceiling so no score change — depth, not movement. job-architecture-shifts-skills-based-not-role-based gained a third independent institution (Deloitte, 501 respondents) showing an anticipation-vs-execution pace gap; breadth 3→4 but composite unchanged at 3 (strength-capped). ai-spine-cross-functional-operating-model enriched with a follow-on MIT CISR briefing (same 132-org digital-colleagues research program); no score change, already at ceiling. Red-teamed this run: all ten evidenceScore≥4 opportunities; only the SOC-automation search cleared the contradiction threshold. Four sources crossed consecutiveEmptyRuns≥6 this run (HBR, NBER, BCG, IDC) — flagged per rubric but likely a quiet-week artifact given how heavily each is already cited, not true abandonment. Both the Claude Artifact and the GitHub Pages mirror published successfully (publish_pages.py and --verify both exited 0).
pagesTokenPermissions: fine-grained PAT, repository access limited to sdm1130/ai-it-research-tracker, Contents: Read and write (Metadata: Read-only is added automatically). Nothing else required: main has no branch protection or rulesets, and Pages is build_type=legacy on main:/ so it rebuilds on push.

pagesPublishExitCodes.3: no credentials — skip and report mirror stale
pagesPublishExitCodes.1: real failure e.g. expired token — report loudly
